cells.quote: In the current follow-up, we found that the UVI indirectly increased persistence through the original effects on course grades, for all students on average and for underrepresented students in particular: better course grades were associated with higher levels of persistence.
cells.note: The study text states that personal focus, but not engagement, mediated the intervention's direct effect on persistence.

D.treatment: utility-value writing assignments for students confident of success

O.outcome_detail: biomedical-track persistence two years later; effect stronger for initially confident students

cells.quote: The intervention had a more positive impact on long-term persistence for students who were more confident that they could succeed at the beginning of the course, and this effect was partially driven by the extent to which students reflected on the personal relevance of biological topics in their essays.
cells.note: This is a moderated treatment effect: the positive intervention effect on persistence was stronger among students with higher baseline confidence.
